steps.name: Build the executable and the Store package
steps.run:
$csproj = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath 'app/PromptFlipper.csproj'
$match = [regex]::Match($csproj, '<StorePackageVersion>(?<v>[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.0)</StorePackageVersion>')
if (-not $match.Success) { throw 'No StorePackageVersion in app/PromptFlipper.csproj' }
./app/Build-PromptFlipperPackage.ps1 -StoreUpload -IdentityName 'RCKeller.PromptFlipper' -Publisher 'CN=D2F3AF1F-4EDD-4F12-88AA-035D5D68B4DF' -PublisherDisplayName 'RC Keller' -PackageVersion $match.Groups['v'].Value
